key_insight: GenEHR is a generative EHR model that learns patient trajectories, including irregular visit timing, to predict future cancer risk across multiple cancer types.
clinical_relevance: The model could help prioritize patients for risk-based screening and earlier evaluation, especially for aggressive cancers such as pancreatic and ovarian cancer.
method: Trained autoregressively on longitudinal EHR data from millions of patients.
Encodes irregular time gaps between visits when forecasting future clinical events.
Uses parameter-efficient supervised adaptation for pan-cancer risk stratification.
evidence_signal: In five large EHR cohorts, supervised adaptation improved prediction of first cancer diagnosis within a five-year horizon.
watch_item: The findings are retrospective, so prospective validation is still needed before using the tool for clinical decision support.
paper_title: Generative model of patient health states and pan-cancer risk stratification
